supportedClinicalScope.declaration: Authentication only; this module makes no clinical decisions.

securityPolicy.downstreamTrust: Downstream modules trust only a successful canonical session response from /api/auth/session; never decode JWT internals or authorize from human-oriented messages.

timeoutPolicy.server: No outbound dependency is used by Authentication.
timeoutPolicy.caller: Callers enforce a bounded request timeout; timeout or transport failure is not authenticated.

errorPolicy.disclosure: Errors and readiness responses contain no secret, signing key, filesystem path, host path, or internal URL.

compatibility.legacySessionPolicy: Read-only compatibility route; downstream authorization must use the canonical session response.
compatibility.jwtPolicy: JWT claims are internal cookie implementation details, not a downstream contract.
compatibility.jwksPolicy: No JWKS endpoint or key-discovery seam exists until signed bearer tokens are introduced.
